findings.evidence: cd remote/e2e && python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_local_e2e.py: exit 1, 0 tests in 7.724 s; setUpClass npm run build fails on duplicate refreshCommandHistory (F19). Fresh report probe C: production fixture events=[], nextCursor=''; att-0001 state reserved; stale and supposedly valid cancel both 409 STALE_PRECONDITION; cancelled transitions=0.

findings.summary: Runbook still omits installing/configuring the private laptop API and reverse tunnel; public Caddy hostname remains an unexplained placeholder.
findings.evidence: Current remote/docs/runbook.md Go-live steps 1-5 cover host gateway and Docker Caddy only; no serve-remote startup, laptop FLOW_GATEWAY_KEY loading, or tunnel installation/start. Caddyfile uses flow.example.com instead of the approved sslip.io hostname; runbook never instructs substitution.

findings.summary: Request logging still writes OAuth code/state query values into the status field.
findings.evidence: Report probe A, exit 0: status=GET /api/auth/callback?code=SYNTHETIC_CODE&state=SYNTHETIC_STATE HTTP/1.1. server.py log_message takes args[0], the full request line, as status.

findings.summary: GET logout bypasses mutation guards, and the CSRF marker accepts any nonempty value rather than 1.
findings.evidence: Report probe A, exit 0: wrong marker POST 200; foreign Origin logout 302; session retained False. server.py uses bool(request_marker); page.tsx still links GET /api/auth/logout.

findings.summary: Telegram retry and alert action/deep-link integration are missing; the previous bad retry envelope was removed rather than repaired.
findings.evidence: Report probe B: submit_telegram_command(retry) raises NameError because CommandValidationError is not imported; app.py allows only pause/resume. telegram_bot.py _send_status constructs only pause/resume callbacks; notifications.py TelegramSender sends chat_id/text only, no reply_markup, and notification_for_event produces at most a fragment, not a frontend URL.

findings.summary: The advertised note command remains accepted by validators but has no laptop dispatcher.
findings.evidence: Report probe B, exit 0: GatewayRuntime._web_command(validate_command(note)) -> real Ledger/dispatch_handlers -> COMMAND_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. note is still in both command enums.

findings.summary: Task brief editing now supplies the task and run precondition, but the phone still cannot edit acceptance criteria.
findings.evidence: Current page.tsx editBriefForm sends task, field='objective', value and run.state; renderTask shows a brief textarea for failed/blocked tasks. No acceptance_criteria editing field or selector exists. bt_remote_commands.dispatch_edit_brief supports acceptance_criteria.

findings.summary: Run-level Reabrir ejecución still sends no task to a dispatcher that requires one.
findings.evidence: Report probe B: dispatch_run_command('reopen', 'demo/REQ-001', {}) raises reopen requiere params.task. page.tsx run-level commandForm('reopen', {kind:'run',...}) supplies no taskId.

findings.summary: An ordinary plan waiting for approval still emits no plan.waiting event without a scheduler decision.
findings.evidence: Report probe B: decision_events([{project:'demo',req_id:'REQ-001',plan_status:'review',decisions:[]}]) returns []; route_get events calls decision_events(plans) and from_snapshot(runs, rounds), which has no plans input.

findings.summary: Restart still loses the cached snapshot and resets SSE IDs without a resynchronization protocol.
findings.evidence: Report probe B: two GatewayRuntime instances with one database yield snapshot before/after restart True/None; a new stream with event 1 returns [] after old Last-Event-ID 1. HTTP _stream_events has no reset event/protocol.

findings.summary: Gateway event history, delivered/dropped outbox/history and abandoned expired sessions remain unbounded.
findings.evidence: Report probe B: stream deque.maxlen None; expired session count 1 after a later login. Source inspection: NotificationOutbox has no 90-day pruning/deletion; SessionStore prunes only a session whose token is presented.

findings.summary: The cachedAt rewrite is corrected, but the gateway still exposes no stable outage-start timestamp and the phone omits sin conexión desde HH:MM.
findings.evidence: Fresh report probe B: failed-probe cachedAt changed=False after _update_laptop_status; that subdefect is corrected. stream.update_laptop_status replaces laptop with online/checkedAt for each probe; no offlineSince is serialized. page.tsx banner remains LAPTOP SIN CONEXIÓN without the outage-start time. Gateway stream tests pass, including offline status and checkedAt.

findings.summary: Laptop redaction still misses provider API-key assignments and bearer authorization text before transmission.
findings.evidence: Report probe B: redact('OPENAI_API_KEY=SYNTHETIC Authorization: Bearer SYNTHETIC') returns both values unchanged. bt_remote_api applies this redactor to review/events; _SECRET_NAMES lists only four credential names.

findings.summary: The earlier absence of an inherited-listener path is corrected in the supplied prerequisite tree.
findings.evidence: cd skill/scripts && python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_platform.py: exit 0, 25 tests in 2.005 s, including test_web_server_reload_uses_the_inherited_listener and test_systemd_listener_requires_its_activation_environment. create_http_server adopts the inherited systemd descriptor; ensure_server uses the unit. No live service was restarted.

findings.summary: The web still discards unknown-outcome envelopes and generates a fresh key on every retry.
findings.evidence: Current page.tsx sendCommand keeps only the returned message, not the command/idempotencyKey; commandForm, roundForm, decisionForm, retryTask and editBriefForm create a new web UUID for every submission.

findings.summary: Published command/event schemas still disagree with production dialects, field names and key limits.
findings.evidence: Report probe B: gateway accepts a 121-character key rejected by laptop's 120 limit; produced run.finished target lacks kind/project/req required by the referenced schema. Source schemas omit answer-decision, specify string route rather than the current route object, and require answer while the web now submits answers.

findings.summary: Default browser verification shares Next.js output and does not terminate successfully; the round assertion still expects answer while the phone sends answers.
findings.evidence: cd remote/web && npm test: stopped by the auditor's 180 s supervisor (180.098 s); before cutoff TAP reported two passing mock tests, OAuth failure at 16.003 s, panel timeout at 90.001 s; no complete totals. Both browser files spawn next dev in the same cwd/.next. panel-browser.test.mjs still asserts command.answer; page.tsx sends answers. Current compilation errors prevent attributing this run to an output race or claiming the old assertion was reached.

findings.summary: The integrated web fails strict typechecking and production compilation: missing FailureReview type, invalid Attempt predicate and duplicate incompatible command-history implementations.
findings.evidence: cd remote/web && npm run verify: exit 2 after lint passes; tsc reports 9 diagnostics: TS2304 page.tsx:36/:57, TS7006 :83 twice, TS2677 :130, TS2322 :135, TS2451 :227/:251, TS2353 :260. T17 invokes the actual npm run build: exit 1, webpack Identifier 'refreshCommandHistory' has already been declared; 0 E2E tests run.

findings.summary: Successful real OAuth sessions cannot load the phone panel because the gateway and web disagree on the session response.
findings.evidence: Fresh report probe B: real authenticated GET /api/auth/session -> 200 {login:'dav033'}. page.tsx load still requires parsedSession.authenticated to be boolean and throws Respuesta de sesión inválida; its initial session===null branch does not render this error. The mock supplies authenticated:true. Runtime browser confirmation is blocked by F19; the real HTTP/consumer contract mismatch is independently reproduced.

findings.summary: The real phone feed cannot connect or decode production events despite mock SSE coverage.
findings.evidence: Report probe B: authenticated GET /api/remote/v1/events/stream?after=abc returns 404. Gateway streams only /api/remote/v1/events and reads Last-Event-ID, while page.tsx uses the former path/query. Laptop snapshot cursor is always empty, and the web refuses to create EventSource without a truthy snapshot cursor. Production event targets use run/task, but parseFlowEvent requires project/req and reads taskId/task_id.

findings.summary: Filling the required env-example values still leaves blank optional settings that prevent gateway startup.
findings.evidence: Report probe B: parsing the checked-in example after filling required synthetic values and GATEWAY_BIND raises Gateway port and timeouts must be numeric; filling numeric settings then raises GitHub OAuth endpoints must use https because blank endpoint assignments override defaults.

findings.summary: A new command-history normalizer preserves origin, but an incompatible duplicate old implementation remains and still substitutes target/command for origin.
findings.evidence: page.tsx:227 defines a commands-endpoint reader with real origin/type/target/submittedAt; :251 redeclares the same const with a history-endpoint reader constructing origin from target/command and an incompatible at field. npm run verify produces TS2451 at both declarations and TS2353 at :260. Neither a working integrated history nor a runtime provenance fix can be claimed until the overlap is resolved (F19).

findings.summary: Installed remote API still cannot answer decisions or rounds: the package manifest omits the new bt_remote_preconditions dependency.
findings.evidence: Fresh report probe D builds wheel and sdist with tests/migration/installed_wheel.py: bt_remote_preconditions.py absent in both. Isolated installed bt_remote_commands.target_state for answer-round and answer-decision each raises ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'bt_remote_preconditions'. The five original remote modules import and installed health test passes; that partial fix does not include the sixth transitive module.

findings.summary: The displayed Ver intento fallido link navigates to a static sample review rather than the selected attempt.
findings.evidence: page.tsx renderTask links every failed attempt to /review with no attempt identity. remote/web/src/app/review/page.tsx imports reviewFixture directly, never fetches an authenticated attempt review, and displays hardcoded att-0019. It now labels DATOS DE MUESTRA, which avoids presenting sample data as live but does not meet the selected-attempt review requirement; static fixture tests pass without exercising the real review endpoint.

findings.summary: The real rejected task state still hides failure review and recovery controls despite the added failed-state/history handling.
findings.evidence: Fresh report probe E: bt_planstatus._SCHEDULER_TASK['recovering']='rejected'; production bt_remote_api._mobile_run preserves that state and emits activeAttempt:null for a non-live rejected attempt, retaining its history. page.tsx review guard requires task.state==='failed'; retry/edit/reopen guards allow failed/blocked only, and no rejected branch exists. bt_remote_views.task_view now returns reviewAttempt, but production _mobile_run does not use it and the phone does not parse it. Current API regression fixture uses failed, not production rejected; F19 independently blocks browser execution.

findings.summary: Command quota is deliberately shared by GitHub login across sessions, rather than maintained per session as R17 specifies.
findings.evidence: Fresh gateway suite: 36 tests pass, including test_command_quota_is_shared_by_owner_across_sessions: 30 commands in owner session A exhaust session B (429); another login remains independent (404 on the test runtime). server.py keys authenticated command/challenge limits by login. This is an aggregate restriction, not an authorization bypass; no owner-approved change to the per-session requirement was found.
